title: Lex Luthor Transforms into Hex Luthor in Superman: Father of Tomorrow
text:
An Elseworlds take on Superman reimagines Jor‑El as Earth's star defender and turns Lex Luthor into a powerful magic user, Hex Luthor, who steals Doctor Fate's helm and threatens new alliances such as the W.I.L.D.C.A.T.S.
DC Comics has long woken the imagination by reimagining its line of gods and villains in surprising ways, and the current Elseworlds story Superman: Father of Tomorrow is a prime example of this creative ambition.
The tale unfolds on an alternate Earth where the famous Kryptonian forefather Jor‑El lands in Kansas and becomes more than a beacon of hope - he is the one who carries the alien technology that helps him ward off Kryptonite, a weakness that even Clark Kent had never quite faced in the main continuity. The U.S. has a new elder hero, and the shadow of villainy looms like a storm on the horizon.
Lex Luthor in this universe is not the same business‑savvy antagonist from the mainstream canon. Driven by resentment after Jor‑El refuses to let him access Kryptonian technology, Lex looks not only to science but to osc..
